artifacts.evidenceSnippetOriginal: All Queen’s University staff and students have access to Microsoft Copilot Chat, providing a secure AI tool to support learning, study, and academic tasks. To use Copilot, please log in using your @qub.ac.uk email address. Logging in this way provides Enterprise Data Protection, and means that your conversations are not used to train public models. Copilot Chat is supported officially on Microsoft Edge and Chrome (using the latest Stable Channel update).
